description: workstation-steward's rules for a config repo's mise toolchain (D39, D40): the 3-day release-age gate, security updates that bypass it, majors and 0.x minors one PR each, exact pins reviewed one by one, everything floating in a weekly digest. Extend it pinned to a release tag: "extends": ["github>pacphi/workstation-steward//renovate/steward#vX.Y.Z"]. The repo adds its own enabledManagers and ignoreDeps.

packageRules.description: Exact-pinned tools (node, npm, and every `npm:` tool): one PR each, reviewed, then `steward sc upgrade-tool` locally. Match on depName (for `npm:<pkg>` tools the packageName is the bare `<pkg>`), with a regex: a glob `*` doesn't match the `/` in scoped names.
Everything else floating on "latest" in mise: weekly digest
Majors are deliberate, and a 0.x minor counts as a major: one PR each, never in the digest
Majors are deliberate: one PR each, never in the digest

The AI tooling add-on owns these (its ai-tooling.toml owned_mise): its qualification decides, so a PR opens only when ticked on the Dependency Dashboard. Security PRs still open at once (vulnerabilityAlerts sets dependencyDashboardApproval false). Harmless where the add-on is off.
